items.text: Tampa Bay QB: Baker Mayfield (foot sprain) DNP Wednesday (Jalon Daniels took first-team reps), then upgraded to limited Thursday and is trending toward starting; Todd Bowles decides Friday. Rookie Jalon Daniels starts if not. Possible late QB change.
Tampa Bay (Wed/Thu): S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) DNP both days. LB Yaya Diaby limited. OT Tristan Wirfs, TE Cade Otton, CB Josh Hayes full. IR - WR Jalen McMillan, LB Christian Rozeboom.

Detroit (Wed est./Thu): C Cade Mays (ankle) DNP both days. S Kerby Joseph (knee) full, Dan Campbell says he will play on a pitch count. LIMITED - CB D.J. Reed (hip, first practice back), CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr., CB Khalil Dorsey, LB Joe Bachie. DE Aidan Hutchinson out for season (ACL). IR - LB Jack Campbell. Jared Goff starts.

adjust.reason: Detroit is still without DE Aidan Hutchinson (season), LB Jack Campbell and C Cade Mays with its corners limited, outweighing Tampa Bay missing S Antoine Winfield Jr., though Kerby Joseph's return narrows the gap. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
